description: Retrieve AI crawler policy guide. Use when you need to decide whether to allow or block an AI crawler. Do NOT use when you need to check AI readiness (check_ai_readiness).
name: crawler_policy_guide

crawlers.description: List of AI crawlers with their respective policies.

allow.description: Rule of thumb for allowing the crawler.

block.description: Rule of thumb for blocking the crawler.

drives_ai_training.description: Indicates whether the crawler drives AI training.

drives_ai_visibility.description: Indicates whether the crawler drives AI visibility.

owner.description: The owner or organization responsible for the AI crawler.

purpose.description: The intended purpose of the AI crawler.

title: Crawler policy guide
